subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should preinstalled sandbox skills be supported through a backend-declared skill inventory/materialization capability, or should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.docker.skipSkillsSync` as a permanent public configuration contract?
rationale: The change adds public configuration and relaxes the current invariant that prompt-visible sandbox skills are materialized by OpenClaw, so implementation review cannot choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Use a backend capability
options.body: Have each supporting sandbox backend expose verified readable skill roots or snapshots so the optimization follows runtime guarantees without another broad config toggle.

options.title: Sponsor the Docker option
options.body: Accept the opt-in Docker setting only after it advertises real sandbox-readable locations, preserves all prompt surfaces, and includes repeated-run live proof.

options.title: Decline the optimization
options.body: Retain unconditional OpenClaw-managed synchronization if maintainers do not want to support externally materialized sandbox skills.

recommendation.title: Use a backend capability
recommendation.body: Have each supporting sandbox backend expose verified readable skill roots or snapshots so the optimization follows runtime guarantees without another broad config toggle.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent pluggable-sandbox and operator-contract history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the ownership decision.
